text:
maria: CI red on main for serializer/golden — failing snapshot for 'assistant_prompt_render'. Looks like trailing-space in serialization output.
ci-bot: Job failed: https://ci.redwood.internal/12345 - failing test: tests/snapshots/test_prompt_roundtrip.py::test_roundtrip (exit 1)
raj: I saw that. Can you repro locally? Try `./tools/run_snapshot.sh --filter prompt_roundtrip -u`
maria: ran that, got local failure. Repro shows subtle diff in choice text spacing.
sam: paste the diff pls, maybe a formatting/indent switch
maria: diff below:
```
- "assistant": "Hello\nHow are you?"
+ "assistant": "Hello\nHow are you? "
```
Extra trailing space at end of assistant text.
tony: trailing-space change could be from PR #4876 (string-normalize). Might be introduced in write path.
maria: PR 4876 did NFD->NFC normalization; suspect a stray strip/append.
raj: quick triage: try rerunning CI with SERIALIZER_FAST=true to force legacy path.
ci-bot: rerun queued: https://ci.redwood.internal/12346 (triggered by @raj)
eva: pinging @sam for a quick review of 4876 — this looks like a regression.
sam: I can take it in ~30m. @maria can you run a git bisect with `git bisect run ./scripts/golden-bisect.sh -- test_prompt_roundtrip`?
maria: starting bisect now, will post results.
maria: bisect found culprit commit 88fa3b2 (string-normalize: strip trailing on write); reverting locally fixes the snapshot.
sam: thanks — opening hotfix revert + test. PR 4980 to revert 88fa3b2 and add a unit to assert trailing-space preservation. ETA ~2h.
ci-bot: Rerun passed: https://ci.redwood.internal/12346 :white_check_mark:
maria: confirmed rerun with SERIALIZER_FAST=true passed, main will stay red until PR 4980 merges.
sam: CC @eva — requesting expedited review.
eva: on it, reviewing now, should be quick.
